label: resolveHit: a scaled blow's hit voice carries `price` (priceN > 0), before the hit-voice line
anchor: SFX.play("hit", self.ultTree ? { dmg, crit, bough: self.w.ult.winDmg } : { dmg, crit });
code:
/* BLOODPRICE'S SCALED BLOW (v81 s4: "a scaled blow -- the sword's strike
       voice pitched DOWN by the stack count (bigger = lower)"): ONE plain
       number more, `price`, the Hemorrhage stacks this blow was priced on
       (`priceN`, read above, before its own onHit), and only when it is > 0:
       a window blow on a body with no Hemorrhage is x1 and keeps the plain
       call. `priceN` is 0 whenever the window is shut and on every other
       relic, so they take the `else` -- the line below, Canopy's call,
       unchanged. `dmg` stays what was dealt. Reads priceN, dmg and crit;
       writes nothing. Presentation only (goreshard_voice_lab: fights
       identical). */
    if (priceN > 0) SFX.play("hit", { dmg, crit, price: priceN });
    else
why: Before the hit-voice line (kept unchanged, the `else`): one guarded SFX.play reading only priceN, dmg and crit, consts the lines above computed. 866/866 scaled blows voiced with `price` = the stacks priceTally counted for them, none of the 358 x1 window blows, 1241 blows outside the window, 3107 foe blows or 177 ward bursts; 148/148 fights identical (a digest of every step included) and every other SFX call identical in order and opts; the row plus one sim write comes back 4/148; end to end, the rows applied as text: 74/74 fights identical to the unpatched page's; the same stage 5 carried onto the batch line's tip (sc-goreshard-b10.25.html c3d5fc24835f91f4): 82/82. Writes nothing; no field for the probe's allowed set.
